name: ytstats
description: Pilot the ytstats CLI from plain English — pull YouTube channel analytics, manage sign-in, switch channels, diagnose failures. Covers 26 commands, the JSON envelope, and interpretation traps.

ytstats.description: The CLI this skill drives. Run via npx without installing, or installed globally for faster startup. 0.6.1 or newer is required. 0.6.0 added the reports/reports-enable/sync/archive commands and the reporting_jobs and reports_archived doctor checks this skill raises unprompted, but on 0.6.0 the seven dataset commands drop an unavailable metric without warning — so this skill's rule that a null column always has a stated reason is false there, and an agent would report a missing metric as a zero.

node.description: Node.js 18 or newer. Required to run ytstats, which is pure JS with no native dependencies.

npx.description: Ships with npm. Used to run ytstats without a global install.

jq.description: Used to extract fields from the JSON envelope without loading whole documents into the conversation.
